title: Search-as-you-type: never show outdated results
blind_spot: Guarding by query value instead of call sequence (a Refresh re-runs the same query), and stale rejections still reaching onError.
prompt: Our search-as-you-type box calls this on every keystroke, and the product also has a Refresh button that re-runs the current query. Tidy this up with JSDoc and make sure users never see outdated results or spurious error toasts. Keep the CommonJS export `createSearch(fetchResults, render, onError)` which returns an async `search(query)`.
